poe.standard: IEEE 802.3af/at (Alternative A, power over data pairs)

features: PoE maximum power per port: up to 25 W
Power consumption stated as up to 280 W (upper bound)
Recording resolution: 12 MP, 8 MP, 6 MP, 5 MP, 4 MP, 3 MP, 1080p, UXGA, 720p, VGA, 4CIF, DCIF, 2CIF, CIF, QCIF
Network: 1 × RJ-45 self-adaptive Ethernet (10/100/1000 Mbps) + 802.3af/at PoE RJ-45 fast Ethernet (10/100 Mbps)
Protocols: HTTP, HTTPS, TCP/IP, IPv4, IPv6, UPnP, RTSP, UDP, DHCP, DNS, DDNS
Supported devices: Ajax cameras, ONVIF-conformant IP cameras, RTSP
Motion detection: Ajax camera: 16 channels, Ajax NVR: 16 channels
AI-powered object detection: People, Pets, Vehicles, Line crossing
AI analytics on third-party cameras: up to 12 channels
Redundancy mode: simultaneous recording of the same streams to two storage devices
Split mode: distributes streams across multiple storage devices
USB: rear panel: 2 × USB 2.0 (Type-A); front panel: 1 × USB 3.0 (Type-A)
Built-in video management system: video wall, event filters, timeline with preview
Visual verification of Ajax system alarms
ONVIF Profile G and S conformant
Accelerometer: alarm when Ajax NVR is moved
